elevate.move: Make the layers story physically lap: each course slides down from above and overlaps the top 1 in. of the course below, covering its nail line as it lands (the nails of the finished course stay visible only on the top board), so the motion itself demonstrates how siding is hung, then reuse that same lap-and-cover action when the visualizer redraws its courses.

Retire the em-dash eyebrows and the decorative nail rows and let the course system carry the section labels: each section opens on a single lap board whose exposed face holds the section title and a real measurement (e.g. '7 in. exposure', '13 squares'), so the motif only appears where it means a board on a wall.
